subject: Is there a way to obtain the appDir from Shiny?

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Is there a way to obtain the appDir from Shiny?
parts:
Currently I am using the paste.exe from GNU to merge csvs together. On Linux shell works fine but in Windows since paste is not native to Windows I have copied the binary to the folder of server.R. But how do I determine the directory in which server.R is situated in Shiny? Is there a command for that?

If I distribute my app there is no way I can determine where the user will extract the server.R to, so I need a way to determine where is the server.R being run is located.

messages.author: 9711d30301c32133
messages.subject: Re: Is there a way to obtain the appDir from Shiny?
parts:
Perhaps I'm misunderstanding the problem, but I don't think there's anything Shiny-specific you need here. Would `getwd()` not give you the current directory of the R session?

Jeff
